args.sql:
SELECT 
    ti.vehiclereg AS vehicle_id,
    ti.shiptransit AS shipment_id,
    dl.datapct AS completion_percentage,
    MAX(rm.riskflag) AS max_container_risk_index,
    ti.distdonekm AS distance_km,
    MAX(sd.tempdevcount) AS max_temperature_deviation_count,
    MAX(sd.critevents) AS max_critical_events,
    MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_temperature_stability_index,
    MAX(c.coolremainpct) AS max_coolant_remaining_percentage
FROM 
    regulatoryandmaintenance rm
JOIN 
    transportinfo ti ON rm.vehgov = ti.vehiclereg
JOIN 
    container c ON ti.containtransit = c.containregistry
JOIN 
    sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
JOIN 
    datalogger dl ON c.containregistry = dl.containlog
WHERE 
    rm.riskflag = 'High Risk'
GROUP BY 
    ti.vehiclereg, ti.shiptransit, dl.datapct, ti.distdonekm
ORDER BY 
    max_container_risk_index DESC
LIMIT 10;

    ti.shiptransit AS shipment_id,

    ti.distdonekm AS distance_km,

    MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_temperature_stability_index,

    regulatoryandmaintenance rm
JOIN 
    transportinfo ti ON rm.vehgov = ti.vehiclereg
JOIN 
    container c ON ti.containtransit = c.containregistry
JOIN 
    sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink

    rm.riskflag = 'High Risk'
